tabs.html:
E-LINK EL-224PS 24-Port PoE Switch with 2 Gigabit Uplink – Reliable Network Solution for D CORE


The E-LINK EL-224PS 24-Port 2 Gigabit Uplink PoE Switch is a high-performance and cost-effective networking solution designed for CCTV surveillance, corporate offices, ISP networks, and enterprise environments in Bangladesh. With 24 PoE ports and 2 Gigabit uplink ports, this switch ensures stable data transmission and efficient power delivery for multiple devices simultaneously.


Key Features


  • 24 × 10/100Mbps PoE Ports – Supports IEEE 802.3af/at standard
  • 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit Uplink Ports – High-speed backbone connectivity
  • Up to 30W per PoE Port – Ideal for IP cameras, Access Points & IP Phones
  • Total PoE Power Budget: 320W
  • 8K MAC Address Table for smooth network performance
  • 6KV Lightning Protection & 8KV Surge Protection
  • Plug & Play Unmanaged Switch – No configuration required
  • Durable metal body & rack-mount design
